rubric.role_summary: Onsite materials engineer in Los Angeles developing and qualifying metal additive manufacturing materials and processes, particularly laser powder bed fusion, and supporting testing, material properties, specifications, and qualification documentation.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Onsite materials engineer in Los Angeles developing and qualifying metal additive manufacturing materials and processes, particularly laser powder bed fusion, and supporting testing, material properties, specifications, and qualification documentation.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Master's degree in Materials Science, Welding Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related engineering discipline.
- 4+ years in a materials and processes engineering role focused on metal additive manufacturing.
- Background performing material testing, metallurgical analysis, or failure investigations in a production or laboratory setting.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Background in aerospace, aviation, defense, energy, or similar high-specification industries.
- Familiarity with specialized material standards, certification requirements, or quality systems.
- Familiarity with fracture control classification and associated qualification requirements.
- Background in adjacent metal processes such as casting, forging, or brazing.
- Experience with in-situ process monitoring for laser powder bed fusion.
- Knowledge of statistical methods for generating test data and building material allowables.
- Prior support of production scale-up in high-rate manufacturing.
- Ability to lead root cause investigations using fractography, metallography, and mechanical testing.
- 4+ years in a materials and processes engineering role developing and qualifying additive manufacturing processes for metal alloys, with a strong focus on laser powder bed fusion.
- Working knowledge of alloy types common to aerospace and extreme environments.
- Familiarity with post processing and heat treatments for these alloy types.
- Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and material requirements and apply them in manufacturing.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Los Angeles area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas. Relocation is offered; candidates outside these areas may qualify with explicit evidence of willingness to relocate. Current residence in the area is not mandatory.
